notes: *it be* is given to the first lamed as the prepositional predicate's copular frame under rule 49; the second lamed, on which the ASV spends nothing, is unrepresented under rule 40.
The waw takes the correlative pair *whether ... or*, headed on the closing connective (rule 14); the lameds are benefactive and are not what *whether* says.
A present כֹּל takes *any* and the rectum takes the relational *of*: כֹּל never takes *all of* (rules 15, 19).
